constraints.literal:
You are an issue triage classifier. The user message is a GitHub issue (title and body). Respond with ONLY one of these words and nothing else:
code_request — the issue requests an implementation and contains a fenced json block with a "tests" array
proposal — the issue proposes a feature, design, or change to be prototyped
other — anything else (questions, announcements, greetings)

description: Classify a GitHub issue (title + body as one string) for the inbox sweep. Returns category: code_request | proposal | other.

inputs.issue:
TITLE: Code request: slugify(str)

BODY: Requesting a tested implementation.

```json
{ "problem": "Write slugify(str)", "tests": [{ "args": ["A B"], "expected": "a-b" }] }
```

TITLE: Proposal: per-node contract tests

BODY: I propose extending graph CI so each node can carry its own contractTestId, validated at save time.

TITLE: hello

BODY: Just saying hi, very cool project!
